name: Married to a Playboy
source:
A handsome stranger saves you from an embarrassing accident, but you don't know his name! Your sexy coworker tells you that he's not over you, and an unfortunate mix-up gives you the opportunity to meet your mysterious savior once again!

[From in-app]
translation:
一个英俊的陌生人将你从一场尴尬的事故中救了出来，但你不知道他的名字！你性感的同事告诉你，他并没有忘记你，而一次不幸的失误让你有机会再次见到你的神秘救世主！

[来自应用程序内]
